lineItems.title: Settlement of 2026 National Examination Registration Charges
lineItems.details: Payment of outstanding 2026 national examination registration fees covering NECO, NABTEB, and NBAIS examinations for eligible students.

lineItems.title: Limintani-Kagadama Road Culverts and Drainage Construction
lineItems.details: Construction of access road culverts and drainage infrastructure to mitigate flooding and protect road infrastructure.

lineItems.title: Sponsorship for Indigenes at Near East University, Cyprus
lineItems.details: Payment of tuition, administrative fees, accommodation, and living allowances for 193 Jigawa indigenes studying Medical and Applied Medical Sciences.

lineItems.title: Renovation of Dilapidated Classroom Blocks
lineItems.details: Rehabilitation and renovation of dilapidated classroom blocks under the 2026 Capital Development Programme.

lineItems.title: Sansani-Ganau-Samai Road Culverts and Drainage Construction
lineItems.details: Construction of access road culverts and drainage infrastructure along Sansani-Ganau-Samai Road with a 16-week completion period.

lineItems.title: Works and Housing Infrastructure Development
lineItems.details: Construction and expansion of urban renewal road networks, state highways, and public housing development projects.

lineItems.title: Basic and Higher Education Expansion
lineItems.details: Constructing and rehabilitating classroom infrastructure, funding student scholarship programs, and upgrading model schools.

lineItems.title: Agriculture and Livestock Enhancement
lineItems.details: Procurement and distribution of fertilizer, irrigation development initiatives, and livestock value chain expansion.

lineItems.title: Healthcare Facilities & Emergency Systems
lineItems.details: Equipping primary, secondary, and tertiary health institutions, alongside expanding the State Emergency Medical Service.

lineItems.title: 361-Ward Community Grassroots Special Projects
lineItems.details: Targeted rural development interventions selected directly by residents during the Citizens' Budget Exercise across all wards.
